newsitem.title: USA: Phillips in Thai chemical plant venture.
newsitem.headline: Phillips in Thai chemical plant venture.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum Co Friday said it signed a memorandum of understanding with PTT Petrochemical Co Ltd to enter into a joint venture that would build, own and operate in Thailand a linear polyethylene plant making 440 million pounds, or 200,000 metric tons a year.
Terms of the agreement were ont detailed.
The facility would be located at Map Ta Phut in Rayong Province, and would use Phillips' proprietary PF loop slurry process technology, the company said.
Construction could begin in the third quarter of 1998, with first commercial production in the third quarter of 1999.
PTT-PC is a subsidiary of the Petroleum Authority of Thailand and the National Petrochemical Public Company Limited, and would supply ethylene to the facility.
Linear high-density polyethylene is used to make plastic pipe, blow-molded bottles, films, ice chests, and other consumer and industrial products, Phillips said.
